html:
A civil war from 1999 to 2003 in which rebel groups, LURD in the north and MODEL in the south, fought the government of Charles Taylor.

In mid-2003 the rebels besieged Monrovia, and shelling killed hundreds of civilians. Women led by Leymah Gbowee protested daily for peace. Taylor left for exile in Nigeria on 11 August 2003, and a peace agreement signed in Accra on 18 August set up a transitional government and a large UN force. The two wars together killed about a quarter of a million people. The peace led to the 2005 election of Ellen Johnson Sirleaf.
sum: A civil war from 1999 to 2003 in which rebel groups, LURD in the north and MODEL in the south, fought the government of Charles Taylor.
